hero.title: Customer problem to reusable IP.

items.title: Start with the outcome
items.description: Every engagement begins by defining what success looks like measurably and in business terms.

items.title: Design for real people
items.description: Solutions are built around the employees, customers and stakeholders who will actually use them.

items.title: Build for scale from day one
items.description: Architecture, security, integration and governance are considered early, not retrofitted later.

items.title: Leave lasting capability behind
items.description: Engagements create reusable foundations and transfer knowledge to client teams.

deliveryModel.title: Customer problem - reusable IP - measurable delivery.
deliveryModel.body: Qlugen builds through a flywheel: customer problem, discover, build accelerator, deploy, learn, productise and reuse.

phases.title: Discover
phases.description: Understand the business challenge, current state, stakeholder priorities and constraints.

phases.title: Define
phases.description: Establish the outcomes, scope, approach and success measures for the engagement.

phases.title: Design
phases.description: Create the solution architecture, user experience and implementation plan.

phases.title: Build
phases.description: Deliver the solution iteratively with continuous integration of feedback and validation.

phases.title: Scale
phases.description: Extend, optimise and hand over the solution with full capability transfer.
